title: 657. Design Log Storage System

examples.explanation: At year precision all three records sit in 2016..2017.
At hour precision only the two 2017 records land inside the window.

hints: Split every timestamp on ':' and keep only the leading parts dictated by the granularity (Year=1 ... Second=6).
A record matches when its truncated stamp sorts no earlier than the truncated start and no later than the truncated end.
Collect one output row per retrieve call in call order; put and constructor calls add no rows.
